known_weaknesses: 13/52 errors, dominant failure mode is an over-eager KEEP bias on content that shares surface keywords/topic with the query but answers a different question (real_8, real_13, real_23, real_24, real_30, real_43) -- the model conflates topical proximity with actual relevance. Secondary failure mode: confused negation/contradiction handling (real_7, real_26) -- similar to the n=16 run's borderline_negation_1 case.
